turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. I have twenty minutes before a client call, Hale. Who decided on that zero, and on what basis?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't come here to be thanked. Your school's own procedure says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and my phone didn't ring. I'm waiting, Hale.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

Ninety-four percent from a piece of software. Turnitin's own guide says that indicator should not be used as the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and I have it printed in my bag. Is that your whole case, or is there something with Owen's name and a date on it?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, and Stanford found seven of them flagging 61 percent of essays by non-native English writers. I'm writing down that your basis for a zero is "quite reliable."
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." Your procedure 4.3 says software results do not by themselves establish a concern, so nothing made you do anything, Hale. Withdraw the zero, or I'm in the principal's office the minute I leave this room.
I hope you understand my position.

Your position is a machine's guess and a zero that skipped every step in your own procedure. Owen wasn't heard, I wasn't called, and he read it on his phone in front of his class. What else do you have?
